text:
sofia-alliances: Quick sync - we need a concrete partner support escalation play for hardware partners + SIs before the marketplace launch. We're seeing ambiguity about who owns field escalations and when we spin up a war room. Proposal: 1) a single partner SEV doc per partner (public to internal teams), 2) shared channel with read-only partner access, 3) phone-tree for P0s, 4) mandatory dry-run before GA. Thoughts?

ramon-sre: +1 to a single canonical doc. For thresholds: P0 = complete outage or data loss -> page within 5m, P1 = severe degradation -> page within 15m. We should list who pages (SRE vs partner ops) in doc.

olivia-ops: For SI partners we need an auth step so their field engineers can join war rooms. Suggest a short onboarding checklist: MSA signed, access form, and SSO invite.

emily-legal: Confirming we need a one-way data-sharing waiver template for debug artifacts (stack traces, screenshots) when partners access logs. I'll draft a 1-paragraph waiver we can attach to the partner doc.

derek-hw-partner: From Titan's side: phone escalation is preferred for P0s. Here's our phone tree example - we can mirror it in the partner doc:```
P0 Phone Tree (example)
1) Partner on-call (call + SMS)
2) Partner engineering lead 10m
3) Partnerops manager 20m
4) Exec on-call 30m
```

warbot: :robot_face: war-room placeholder created: https://war.room/1749123456 

chet-field-eng: Also add a checklist for on-site field engineers: VPN access, kube-readonly, and a single temp-scoped S3 bucket for logs. That reduces friction.

ramon-sre: Operational notes: shared channels must be partner-read-only, with two Redwood editors (SRE lead + PartnerOps lead). Pin: contact matrix, runbook link, and the oncall-ack command. Include an `!ack` bot command so we record pager ownership.

sofia-alliances: Decisions: 1) Use 5m/15m thresholds for P0/P1. 2) Create partner doc template (contact matrix, phone tree, runbook, legal waiver link, access checklist). 3) Shared channels read-only for partner. 4) Mandatory pre-GA dry-run.

sofia-alliances: Action items: - olivia-ops -> create the onboarding checklist + SSO template (due Tue EOD). - emily-legal -> draft waiver paragraph & quick review cycle (due Tue). - ramon-sre -> add !ack to our incident bot and update SRE playbook with thresholds (due Wed). - derek-hw-partner -> confirm Titan phone tree and contact list for doc (due Wed). - chet-field-eng -> produce field engineer access checklist (due Wed). I'll coordinate the dry-run scheduling once these are ready.

derek-hw-partner: Sounds good. I'll upload Titan contact CSV to the shared drive and DM sofia the primary phone numbers.

sofia-alliances: thanks everyone. If any partner has a different legal requirement (e.g., export controls), flag it now so we can include an exceptions section. :wave:
